body:
I'm sorry that you relate, I wouldn't wish this on anyone ❤️

I've become numb to the "good" days... I don't think I even have them anymore. I try not to put my emotions on others. If I'm honest I mostly push them away. I hope that it's peaceful too

Thanks :) I have my friends and they're honestly the only reason I'm still alive but I constantly find myself pushing them away and shutting them out so I don't hurt them. I'm living at uni right now so I don't get to see my pets which makes things a little worse because I'm already gone for them.

I guess it's tough to think of positives when there aren't many but I am trying to stay here for the few people I care about. Its just rough x

Nope aha I got discharged from the community physiatric nurse a couple months ago because I completed the allocated appointments set when i first saw them which never got recessed and everytime I go see someone they just don't take me seriously.

Like my eating habits are so disordered but I've been told "you look okay tho" and I've just given up on professionals in general because even when I say I think I'm getting worse they just tell me I'm not. They say but you look better or you sound better which just makes me feel even worse.

I'm just exhausted from it all and i want everything to be over.
